notes:
Lead profile: mid-stage SMB (support SaaS). Primary contact: Emma R. (Head of Product) + CTO Marco.

Summary of needs:
- Main workloads: real-time support-agent (chat), doc search reranking for KB, nightly summarization of tickets.
- Latency targets: conversational p50 < 200ms, p95 < 500ms for hosted API.
- Throughput: baseline 10–30 RPS during peak; cost sensitive (monthly cap ~ $6k).
- Model preference/questions: evaluating tradeoffs between Llama variants (open-weight Llama-2-13B), Mistral-instruct (7B/11B), and Qwen (7B/14B). They asked: "Can we get GPT-4-like helpfulness for edge cases without paying a premium?"

What they told us (paraphrased / quotes):
- "We want better-than-GPT-3.5 accuracy on policy/answering but we can't triple our inference bill."
- "Fallback cheaper models for non-critical prompts is fine — but we need predictable quality for legal/ROQA cases."

Specific technical asks / constraints observed:
- Want guidance on instruction-tuned vs base weights for hosted API (which models are better out-of-box for instruction-following).
- Interested in quantized model variants if Redwood provides verified perf/cost projections.
- Routing policy interest: route to higher-quality model for escalations, cheaper model for generic replies; want examples of routing config and cost delta.
- Cache/prefix reuse: high potential — many KB lookups share prefixes; would like recommendations to reduce token spend.

Preliminary eval notes submitted by customer (internal):
- Llama-2-13B: highest quality on long-context QA but ~2x cost vs Mistral-7B on our infra/metrics; latency acceptable for p50 but p95 spikes.
notes_continued:
- Mistral-Instruct-7B: very promising for instruction-style completions, lower cost; occasional hallucination on specific legal phrasing.
- Qwen-7B: fastest in hosted tests, best latency & cost; quality gap vs Llama-13B on complex multi-step prompts.

Open questions we need to answer for them:
1) Provide a concise cost/quality matrix (token cost estimate, latency profile, sample outputs) for Llama-2-13B, Mistral-Instruct-7B, Qwen-7B, and fallback strategies.
2) Recommend default routing policy for support use-case and show how to configure in Redwood Console (can we ship a template?).
3) Clarify hosted API SLAs for SMB self-serve and what enterprise-only features (dedicated pools) cost.
4) Provide minimal eval harness and instructions to run local comparisons against their KB (we suggested a 100-prompt test set).

Next actions (owner: Ravi / SE Melanie):
- Deliver one-page cost vs quality comparison + 3 sample prompt outputs by 2026-03-15.
- Share short eval harness repo link (example prompts + scoring) and a suggested routing policy template.
- Schedule 60min deep-dive with Emma + Marco (week of 3/17).

Sticking points / risks:
- They will likely start with hosted to avoid infra ops, but will push back if latency/p95 issues emerge.
- Budget ceiling (~$6k/month) requires realistic cost modeling — if Llama-13B routinely doubles cost, they may pick Mistral/Qwen.
